name: firefox_antidetect_patch
notes: The repository holds the patch folders (automation, fingerprint, network, platform), a SERIES file giving their order, UPSTREAM.json with the Mozilla tag and build tooling under tools/. Its maintainer guide, AGENTS.md, is in Italian.
summary: A Firefox patch series against a Mozilla release tag, one folder per feature, that adds engine-level fingerprint, network and Juggler automation patches and builds the anti-detect Firefox behind invisible_playwright.
